content.title: OTIS Q3 Deep Dive: Service Momentum Drives Growth Amid New Equipment Headwinds
content.summary: Elevator manufacturer Otis (NYSE:OTIS) reported Q3 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 4% year on year to $3.69 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $14.55 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.05 per share was 4.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
